Earlier reports indicated that WhatsApp was developing new chat themes, and this feature is now rolling out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat themes include animated wallpapers

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now rolling out five new chat theme categories: Featured, Nature, Animated, Minimal, and Doodle. Just two weeks ago, the website discovered references to a new theme gallery in the app's code.

The website states that "Featured" includes the "best themes" curated by WhatsApp's design team; the "Nature" category "brings the outdoors into the chat screen"; "Animated" offers "wallpapers that move slowly in the background"; the "Minimal" theme "applies a solid color to the chat screen: white in light mode and black in dark mode"; finally, "Doodle" is WhatsApp's classic wallpaper with doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's description of the "Animated" wallpapers, arguably the most eye-catching new feature:

WABetaInfo mentions that WhatsApp will automatically match the conversation bubble colors based on the selected theme, adding that, as with the rollout of other WhatsApp features, the new functionality may not be available to all users immediately.
